patches.name: Use Morphe YouTube Music for alarms
patches.description: Redirects Google Clock to the Morphe YouTube Music package.

targets.description: Verified against Google Clock 9.0 build 943154005 / versionCode 76073630.

patches.name: Google Clock alarm MediaBrowser bridge
patches.description: Short-circuits YT Music's MediaBrowser capability gate before it can publish PlaybackState ERROR(7), keeps browse entitlement metadata coherent, bypasses the DeskClock browse-consent detour, and enables background alarm playback.

patches.name: Google Clock alarm MediaBrowser bridge v2
patches.description: Adds the YT Music loadChildren gate fix that prevents the Premium PlaybackState error after Google Clock subscribes. Depends on the base Google Clock alarm MediaBrowser bridge.

patches.name: Google Clock MediaBrowser upstream compatibility
patches.description: Isolated port of the upstream YT Music MediaBrowser unlock: bypasses the caller certificate gate and restores the original com.google.android.apps.youtube.music identity inside search_media_items.

targets.description: Experimental upstream MediaBrowser compatibility port for Morphe-patched YT Music 9.15.51.

patches.name: Google Clock MediaBrowser full bridge
patches.description: Full Google Clock/YT Music MediaBrowser chain: root/entitlement/consent fixes, upstream package identity/certificate compatibility, loadChildren capability and client allow-list bypasses, plus the cached browse-error fast-path bypass that was still returning empty children and the Music Premium PlaybackState ERROR(7).

patches.name: Google Clock MediaBrowser error stack diagnostic
patches.description: Temporary diagnostic that dumps the call stack from both known YT Music MediaBrowser error publishers (Llin.e and Lkzf.f). Depends on the full bridge.

targets.description: Temporary diagnostic for Morphe-patched YT Music 9.15.51.
